description: If the stated transitive ZFC ground model additionally satisfies \(2^{\aleph_0}\ge\aleph_3\), its old injection from \(\omega_3^M\) into the binary reals remains in the many-Cohen extension. Cardinal preservation therefore gives \(2^{\aleph_0}\ge\aleph_3\) there and rules out equality with \(\aleph_2\). The internal model/cardinal statement is unbound.
